name: miran
description: Motion graphics, directed by your agent: the Miran Fann GPU engine on your Mac (scenes, motion, 3D camera, sound, voice, critique and render tools, plus a live viewer) and eight skills that teach your agent to direct and make finished films.

interface.shortDescription: Design, animate and render motion graphics with Miran Fann.
interface.longDescription: Miran Fann is a GPU motion-graphics engine driven by tool calls: compositions of layers with keyframed transforms, text, shapes, generators, particles, effects, masks, a 3D camera and audio, rendered to PNG and MP4/HEVC/ProRes. Build a scene beat by beat with runScript (JavaScript calling the tools), look at contact sheets returned as images, and export. toolCatalog, describeTool and guide document every tool and convention.
defaultPrompt: Make a 10-second product teaser with Miran Fann.
Animate this headline with a premium kinetic-type entrance in Miran.
Render my Miran composition to a high-quality MP4.
Open the Miran Fann live viewer so I can watch the timeline while you build.
